text: A body of mass 2 kg is moving with velocity 10 m/s. What is its kinetic energy?

subject: Physics

text: Which law states that an object at rest stays at rest unless acted upon by an external force?
textHindi: कौन सा नियम कहता है कि जब तक कोई बाहरी बल कार्य न करे तब तक विरामावस्था में वस्तु विरामावस्था में ही रहती है?
subject: Physics
explanation: Newton's First Law also known as the law of inertia.
